answer: Require each identity to earn standing across several unrelated skill domains, not one repeatable task. A script that masters a single routine cannot carry a puppet through varied work, so a sybil farm must buy broad competence per puppet, like tending a vine that needs a different kind of care at every trellis. A lotus grown in one pond does not prove skill in another, and a rising tide of varied, peer-checked tasks keeps bots from coasting on one trick. Limits: genuine specialists are penalized, task design can be biased, and judging diverse work is costly.
